messages:
sam: Quick sync — RefKit Lite launch: we need to lock webinar date, benchmark narrative, and inbound lead routing for the signup form. High-level goals: showcase fast dev onboarding, demo refapp, and push attendees to the tutorial + repo.

anika: I can own the webinar script and host the demo. Prefer week of Oct 4 — gives us 3 weeks to prep. :calendar:

liam: I'll own the reference app repo + demo slides. Can we include a small hands-on lab at the end (30 mins)? attendees should leave with a cloned repo + 1 runnable example.

josh: I have rough perf numbers for the default config vs quantized. Will pull a short table by EOD. For the marketing post we should call out: median latency, cost per 1k tokens, and model switch fallbacks.

maria: For the launch post copy, let's avoid raw numbers in top-level hero — instead say "sub-second median token latency on common prompts" and link to benchmark section with details.

sam: Good call. Action items: @anika script draft, @liam demo + repo, @josh benchmark table, @maria post draft and landing form. Also need inbound routing so leads from the webinar sign-up go to marketing CRM and devrel.

liam: For the inbound mapping, recommend a webhook that tags source=refkit-lite-webinar and interest=refapp/tutorial. Quick mapping I use for the website:

```json
{
  "source": "refkit-lite-signup",
  "route": "crm:marketing, slack:devrel",
  "fields": {
    "email": "email",
    "company": "company",
    "role": "role",
    "interest": "interest"
  },
  "tags": ["refkit-lite","webinar"]
}
```

sam: Perfect. @devrel-bot can we get a Slack channel created to surface hot leads to oncall devrel? maybe `#devrel-inbound-refkit`

devrel-bot: Created channel #devrel-inbound-refkit and posted webhook URL. :robot_face:

josh: Bench note — two quick numbers: baseline (fp16): ~95ms/token median on test harness; int8-quant: ~62ms/token with ~1.5% quality delta on our eval set. I'll formalize into a small table and a short blurb comparing cost/latency tradeoffs.

anika: Draft webinar outline (very rough): 1) 5m intro + value props 2) 10m refapp walkthrough 3) 15m live demo + runbook 4) 25m hands-on lab 5) 5m Q&A. Thoughts?

maria: Looks good. For the blog/launch post structure: TL;DR hero, how-to copy, benchmark section (collapsible), tutorial links, CTA -> repo + sign up. Add a short testimonial quote from an early tester.

sam: Ok let's aim for webinar on Oct 7 11am PT. Deadline checklist: draft copy + landing page by Sep 20, webinar slides + demo repo by Sep 28, benchmarks + detailed appendix by Sep 30. I'll set a calendar invite after we confirm times.

liam: I'll start a repo under org/refkit-lite and add a minimal README + quickstart script. Will ping when PR is ready.

maria: I'll draft the landing form fields to match the webhook mapping and include an optional checkbox: "I want a hands-on workshop followup."

josh: Also recommend a small benchmark notebook in the repo so folks can reproduce numbers — I'll add that to the PR.

anika: Awesome. If anyone has objections to Oct 7 shout now, otherwise I’ll start drafting script + slides.

sam: No objections from me. :thumbsup: Thanks all — will post a short tracker doc and assign calendar invites.
